reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin focused on maintaining conversation context through near-limit session continuation, with an additional configurable persona feature.

summaries.zh: 用于为 DeepSeek Harness 追加可配置的人格提示，并在 WebUI 会话接近上下文上限时自动创建新会话交接最近一轮内容。
summaries.en: Adds a configurable persona to DeepSeek Harness and automatically starts a new WebUI session with the latest exchange when the current context nears its limit.

capabilities: Appends an optional whale-maid persona section to model prompts
Adds a tool for rereading the configured persona
Monitors WebUI context pressure and creates a new Workspace session near the configured limit
Transfers the last user request and assistant reply into the new session
Stores persona configuration and continuation mappings locally
